text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened one day when I visited a cafe 
inside the VR Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Oh! If it isn't our little lamb. Having 
tea time in the virtual world, are we?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Taking a breather is just as important as 
the calm before the storm, is it not desu 
wa? Would you care to join us, if you 
please?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we are interested in hearing your 
tales. We cannot directly observe how the 
Umamusume usually fare in their daily 
lives.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I spoke about the 
noteworthy things I had recently seen from 
the Umamusume around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's a thick book! What's it 
called... "Journeys of Renowned 
Umamusume"...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's a record of the Umamusume who 
challenged GⅠ races. For some reason, I 
just keep picking it up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So that the hopes of generations of the 
Satono family can be rewarded, I want to 
engrave my own hoofprints here too. 
...That is what I strongly feel.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! Amazing! Did something happen 
recently that fired you up so much?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... I suppose it's because I went on a 
journey with a free-spirited Goddess. 
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... After sprinting full 
bakushin... as class president... I must 
patrol the cla-classrooms~~...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! Bakushin O-san, even though you're 
stumbling like that...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...To connect with someone, I need 
courage...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Bakushin O-san! Um... I-I found a 
wonderful cafe! So... won't you take a 
break with me, just for a little bit...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...! Jeez, what is it desu wa!? You 
have been staring intensely at my practice 
for a while now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not really anything~? I was just watching 
and thinking that I can't afford to lose 
either, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So come on, don't mind me, don't mind me♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is something suspicious about this 
desu wa... However, I do not need you to 
tell me that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...No one can grow alone, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You better get stronger, McQueen. 
...Together with me, alright!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! Congratulations, Rice-chan. You 
did splendidly desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So she did.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Oho? It's rare to see your cheeks soften 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...What is wrong with being pleased that 
the Umamusume are devoting themselves to 
self-improvement?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're absolutely right! There is no 
greater bliss for us than this!
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could bring you good news.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Of course, whatever form it takes! After 
all, we desire the growth of all 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
To show the path, and watch over the backs 
of the Umamusume forging ahead. That is 
the reason we are here.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
If our vast records could be of even the 
slightest help, it is truly our honor desu 
wa.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Rich coming from you, greenhorn. You too 
are in a position to show the way.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
How about you, little lamb? Don't you have 
a future you wish for <chrname>?
choice_data_list: I want her to enjoy racing 'freely'.

I want her to master 'her own' style of 
running.

I want to raise her into a 'tenacious' 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Nice, exactly right! Everyone should 
follow their own will!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
To achieve that— Little lamb, you must 
become freer than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, how could you ever demonstrate 
true freedom?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
What moments make you feel joy? Let's go 
experience them—right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, I traveled around various 
places with her... and learned what true 
'freedom' really meant.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that is the case, I can certainly 
teach you. Let me see desu wa...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
How about gazing out at the sea? It is 
wonderful for facing oneself and having an 
inner dialogue desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Above all... it brings soothing peace. 
Sometimes, one might even lose track of 
time just watching the waves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, I gazed at the sea alongside 
her and soothed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, 'tenacity'? That entails forging not 
only the body, but the spirit as well.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, as her instructor, you must 
become 'tenacious' too.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Very well, we shall start with physical 
training. First, 100 push-ups.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Too harsh? Then I shall cut it in half. 
With me sitting on your back instead... 
what is your choice?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, I did push-ups with her on my 
back and learned what true tenacity was! 
...Though in the days that followed, I had 
to rest due to extreme muscle soreness.
